highlights.title: Removing an account works mid sign-in
highlights.line: If you left a Sign in again unfinished on an OpenAI or Grok account, you can now remove that account instead of waiting for it to time out.

highlights.title: Save a diagnostics file for help
highlights.line: Settings, Advanced, Save diagnostics makes one file for the people who build Kosmos. Keys, email addresses and user folders are taken out.

highlights.title: Late recurring runs say what they missed
highlights.line: When a recurring task runs after scheduled runs that never happened, its activity now counts the runs it missed.

highlights.title: Agents not run in two weeks say so
highlights.line: An agent that is not running and has not run for 14 days or more says so on its card, and says where to remove it.

highlights.title: Reply to Claude questions by number
highlights.line: When a Claude agent asks you to pick one option, replying with its number reaches it as your answer, not the highlighted default.
